verdict.rationale: The SDK's Hooks feature explicitly lets users define callbacks that run automatically on agent events (tool calls, session start, execution stop), including blocking dangerous operations before they execute, and permission 'rules' define what's allowed automatically — directly matching the event-triggered rule story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of hooks in real deployments and richer examples of custom (non-blocking) automated actions beyond permission gating.
